# DREAMVISION EDUCATION

> DreamVision Education supports international study and career planning, pre-arrival preparation, and New Zealand nursing-registration preparation. The organisation is based in Kerala, India, and serves people exploring opportunities in New Zealand, Australia, and the United Kingdom.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://dreamvisionedu.au/): Overview of DreamVision Education services.
- [Study and nursing services](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses): New Zealand nursing-registration preparation.
- [IQN Learning App](https://dreamvisionedu.au/iqn-learning-app): Pre-launch information for the DreamVision IQN Learning App. The app is in development; availability and store links are not yet confirmed.
- [IQN theoretical exam preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/iqn-training): Preparation information for the New Zealand IQN theoretical exam.
- [OET and IELTS preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/oet-preparation): English-language exam preparation.
- [OSCE preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/osce-training): Clinical assessment preparation.
- [About DreamVision](https://dreamvisionedu.au/about): Organisation and service approach.
- [Contact](https://dreamvisionedu.au/contact): Enquiry options and office details.
- [Articles](https://dreamvisionedu.au/blog): Guidance articles about nursing registration and exam preparation.

## Notes
- DreamVision Education is independent and is not the Nursing Council of New Zealand.
- Immigration and visa advice should be obtained from a licensed immigration adviser or the relevant government authority.
